sceneConcept: A slim thirty-one-year-old Chinese network-architecture researcher stands alone against a transparent background. Short untidy brown hair, rectangular glasses, light stubble and alert brown eyes suggest rapid thought. He wears a blue-and-grey plaid collared shirt with rolled sleeves, charcoal trousers, a black belt and plain dark sneakers.
